name: Mudry CAP 10
summary: French two-seat side-by-side aerobatic trainer used by air forces and aerobatic schools; wooden construction with a distinctive ventral fin.

wings: Low-set cantilever wing with large ailerons
fuselage: Two seats side by side under a large bubble canopy
Fixed tailwheel gear with sprung main legs
tail: Small ventral fin below the rear fuselage and a large rudder

tellTales: Low-wing aerobatic taildragger with two seats side by side
Large bubble canopy over a short, cowled four-cylinder engine
Small ventral fin under the tail

confusedWith.howToTell: The Extra has tandem seats (or one seat) and a six-cylinder engine with a three-blade prop; the CAP 10 has side-by-side seats and a two-blade prop.
The Citabria is a high-wing tandem taildragger; the CAP 10 is a low-wing with side-by-side seats.
The DA20 has tricycle gear and a flat wide canopy; the CAP 10 is a taildragger with a ventral fin.
